# Keryx Solutions

> Keryx Solutions is a software consulting firm led by Bala Bosch. It builds custom software, AI-powered tools, and scalable architecture for startups and growing businesses — expertly engineered.

Use this site to understand the company's consulting focus, founder background, delivery approach, selected portfolio, and how to start a conversation.

Key points:

- Best suited for startups and growing businesses that need senior hands-on technical leadership.
- Strong fit for architecture modernization, codebase streamlining, AI-assisted workflows, and product engineering.
- The company emphasizes practical outcomes, maintainability, and user-centered delivery.

## Primary resources

- [Homepage](https://keryxsolutions.com/): Main overview of services, founder background, portfolio summary, FAQ, and contact call to action.
- [Motory Group case study](https://keryxsolutions.com/work/motory-group/): How a growing buy-here-pay-here auto group consolidated five dealership websites into one auto-mall platform, with measured traffic and lead results.
- [Dealership website cost breakdown](https://keryxsolutions.com/cost-breakdown/): A one-page breakdown of per-location licensing versus one platform for the whole group, from Motory Group's published case-study numbers. Emailed, no call required.
- [Machine-readable company overview](https://keryxsolutions.com/site.md): Concise summary of services, ideal clients, technology focus, and engagement model.
- [Selected work](https://keryxsolutions.com/work.md): Representative projects and delivery themes.
- [Buyer FAQ](https://keryxsolutions.com/faq.md): Answers to common questions about fit, services, AI, and how to get started.

## Insight answers

Short direct-answer pages on practical AI agent engineering, each answering one question:

- [Detect an AI agent workflow going off track](https://keryxsolutions.com/insights/detect-off-track-ai-agent-workflows/): Outcome checks, budgets, assertions, and traceability that catch an off-track run before it compounds.
- [Version AI agents without breaking workflows](https://keryxsolutions.com/insights/version-ai-agents-without-breaking-workflows/): Agent definitions in version control, pinned models, contract tests, and staged rollout.
- [Make AI workflow database updates succeed or fail together](https://keryxsolutions.com/insights/database-updates-succeed-or-fail-together/): Single-transaction writes, idempotency keys, and the outbox or saga pattern when writes span systems.
- [Reliable multi-agent research workflows](https://keryxsolutions.com/insights/reliable-multi-agent-research-workflows/): One orchestrator, bounded verifiable delegation, checkpoints, and failure discipline for runs that finish.
